title: CTFy
description: Fast, minimal, and container-free CTF platform for cybersecurity clubs, hackathons, and quiz competitions.
details: CTFy bridges competition design and instant live hosting into a single, distraction-free environment. You get real-time PIN-gated arenas with markdown challenges and downloadable assets, alongside Supabase-replicated live scoreboards and host telemetry — with zero container maintenance, zero client secret leaks, and full server-side flag verification.

title: KubeSense
description: High-density, terminal-based Kubernetes monitoring dashboard with real-time metrics, live log tailing, and AI-driven log anomaly detection.
details: KubeSense is an advanced, terminal-based User Interface (TUI) tool specifically designed for real-time Kubernetes pod monitoring. By leveraging the official Kubernetes Python API and the Textual framework, KubeSense delivers a high-density, system-monitor style dashboard directly to your command line.
